proof_summary: Ascending trial division is shown to produce the ordered prime factorization, with every composite characterized here by a factor list of length at least two; exhaustive blockwise modular evaluation then shows that every such case below the bound has nonzero remainder. At the endpoint, \(28749=3\cdot7\cdot37^2\) and \(373737=13\cdot28749\), giving the required zero remainder.
